website.note: Pipeline page lists phase headers but no specific asset names; Evotec discloses pipeline as aggregated 140+ co-owned partner-led assets

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Evotec is primarily a contract research organization (CRO) and drug-discovery partner. Most clinical-stage assets in its 'co-owned pipeline' (140+ programs) are sponsored and developed by partners (Bayer, BMS, Novo Nordisk, Sandoz, Bristol Myers Squibb, etc.) — they appear under partner names on registries and are excluded per task rule (partner-owned trials). Only Just-Evotec Biologics' JST-010 is an Evotec-sponsored active clinical asset.

pipeline.license_origin: Just-Evotec Biologics (Evotec subsidiary) under U.S. government biodefense funding

indications.trial_design: Phase 1 randomized double-blind dose-escalation/expansion in healthy adults

excluded_legacy_terminated: EVT 101 (NMDA NR2B antagonist) — Phase 1 completed, not active
excluded_partner_owned: Bayer co-developed Alport-syndrome program (Phase 2 initiated Dec 2025)
Bristol Myers Squibb molecular glue BMS-986506 (Phase 1 RCC, Mar 2026)
Bristol Myers Squibb CELMoD program (Phase 1 planned 2026)
Other 140+ co-owned partner-led discovery / clinical programs
blockers: Foreign private issuer (no 10-K). Business model is CRO/co-discovery; pipeline transparency limited because partner sponsors disclose trials under their own names.
